LAYOUT: All four panels are present and correctly placed. Top-left: Causal chain diagram. Top-right: Recorded series (live) line plot. Bottom-left: 32-bit float32 bit-pattern strip. Bottom-right: Monospace state card HUD.

SERIES: The line plot shows four series (w, delta w, gradient, loss) in the legend. However, the plot area is effectively empty of data lines or points; only a horizontal baseline near 0.1 is visible. The purple circular marker is visible at the far left edge (x=0). The trend is flat/empty as no series data is rendered within the coordinate space.

TEXT: Step 12 / 59; w = -0.7580891492652803; loss = 3.6818940630394958; FPS readout = 10 FPS drawn | step rate 25/s (top-right) and 16 FPS drawn (state card); bits changed = 9 of 32.

BITS: 32 bit squares are drawn. Orange squares (changed this step) are located at indices: 7, 8, 20, 24, 25, 26, 27, 30, and 31. The hex word is 0xBF424151.

DEFECTS: The top-right "recorded series" panel fails to render the actual data lines for any of the four tracked series, leaving the main plotting area blank despite having a legend and axis labels. Additionally, the purple marker is pinned to the extreme left edge (x=0), partially clipped by the y-axis.

VERDICT: FAIL - The primary data visualization panel (recorded series) is missing its plotted data lines, rendering the dashboard's core monitoring function inoperative for this frame.
